findings.title: Protect successful Popen immediately inside the constructor

findings.title: Avoid signalling a reaped or reused process-group identifier
findings.evidence: main polls/waits and reaps before finally close(). Linux close unconditionally invokes killpg(self.pid); stored start-tick identity is never consulted. Already-reaped/stale fake still reaches SIGKILL on the numeric identifier, which can be reused after reap.
findings.correction: Do not signal after the owned direct child is reaped; while unreaped use retained identity/start/group ownership and fail closed on mismatch. Freeze the actual termination/reap/group-absence order so no unrelated reused group can be killed.
